scientific_integrity: Analytical finite-degree orthogonality, root monotonicity and matched limit derivations, using the cited established general sign-uncertainty theorem. Standalone numerical checks are supplementary. No independent verification.
scientific_limitations: The general paraorthogonal root characterization and sharpness theorem are due to Ismoilov (2026). The new assertion is the degree-dependent atom-strength crossover and local extremizer profiles for a single Haar-plus-atom family. Historical priority for the asymptotic not independently established. No uniform finite-m error or multiple-atom result is claimed.
title: A critical point-mass boundary layer for sharp circular sign uncertainty
